notes.title: Important announcement
notes.content: Hey everyone, I just wanted to let you in on something pretty important for Hoven Indies. Hoven 2 the Grim Gates has entered its alpha stage and will be available for download on the Hoven indies website within 24 hours! The downloads will be available for PC and Mac. In celebration of this, Hoven the Sages Spinel will be 30% off all of next week! Thank you all for your support and have a nice day!

notes.title: Major Patch
notes.content: I am so very sorry to all of those who have experienced any of the major glitches that have been occuring lately. I've found the source of the problem and have fixed it! The issue was I had renamed a graphics file and it threw off the system. Sorry again, and have a good day!

notes.title: How to access DLC quest.
notes.content: To access the newly added DLC quest, the Lich's Curse, you must first complete the game's main story quest, aka defeating the final boss. After you have done so there will be 3 pages of a mysterious journal hidden throughout the world. The locations of these pages are: The Comidoca Library in Red's office, Ms. Lou's Library, and the Kijahd Elder. Please note that the pages MUST be found in that order. After gathering all pages, you need to head to the old Kijahd tower in the desert, and there is where the main part of the quest starts. Also note that the recommended level for this quest is 50. Good luck!
